Why I started this

Since launching HER HORIZONS AI this week, one thing has really struck me: there are so many women working in AI.

I know women who are building businesses, leading AI projects, working in data and engineering, strategy, transformation, research and product. But honestly, we don't always know where each other are. And I think that's a shame.

That's really why I started HER HORIZONS AI. I wanted to create a space where we can actually find each other — to connect, have conversations, share what we're working on, ask questions, exchange ideas, and hopefully open a few doors for each other along the way.

Not this

  • Not another course
  • Not another generic “women in tech” initiative
  • Not about putting women in a separate box

Just this

  • A place to connect with other women in AI
  • Real conversations about what we're each working on
  • Questions, ideas, and a few doors opened for each other

What are you working on in AI right now?

Tell us in the comments — even one sentence. If you're a woman working in AI, welcome.
